CustomField.formula: TEXT( IF( MOD(FLOOR((CreatedDate + 0.2291667 - DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate + 0.2291667)) & " 00:00:00")) * 24), 12) = 0, 12, MOD(FLOOR((CreatedDate + 0.2291667 - DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate + 0.2291667)) & " 00:00:00")) * 24), 12) ) ) & ":" & LPAD( TEXT( FLOOR(MOD((CreatedDate + 0.2291667 - DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate + 0.2291667)) & " 00:00:00")) * 1440, 60)) ), 2, "0" ) & " " & IF( FLOOR(MOD((CreatedDate + 0.2291667 - DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate + 0.2291667)) & " 00:00:00")) * 24, 24)) < 12, "AM", "PM" )
CustomField.label: ATT TIME
